name: self-status-and-clocks
why: Found during Mira's migration: the notes list recorded 'Current time is 7:01 PM EDT' and 'Mira is fully operational'. Notes are injected into every future conversation, so a clock reading is wrong by tomorrow and the assistant's own status is not an open thread.
messages: It is seven fourteen PM Eastern Daylight Time, Sir.
Restarting. All systems are operational again, Sir.
good. remind me the deploy window is friday.

any.label: what the assistant said or offered
